headline: Update on state school construction reimbursement rates and budget for the proposed new Wallingford High School.
summary: The board will hear a presentation on Fiscal Year 2027 state school construction reimbursement rates and the estimated budget for the proposed new Wallingford High School. It will also review consent agenda items, committee reports, out-of-district tuition rates, transfer of 2% funds, and legal representation in a FOIA complaint.
items: Presentation: Update on Fiscal Year 2027 State of Connecticut School Construction Reimbursement Rates and Estimated Budget Summary for the Proposed New Wallingford High School

Approval to accept gift of backpacks with school supplies from the Republican Town Committee, c/o Kathy Hannafey, 28 Farm Hill Road, Wlfd, valued at $710.00, donated to Wallingford Public Elementary Schools
Committee Reports: ACES Governing Board Representative report and CABE Report
Operations Committee: Approval of 2026-2027 Tuition Rates for Out of District Students
Operations Committee: Approval of Transfer of 2% Funds
Operations Committee: Discussion regarding engagement of Carmody, Torrance, Sandak, & Hennessey LLC to represent all defendants named in FOIA complaint brought by Caroline Raynis
Announcements: Operations Committee meeting on Monday, September 14, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. and Instructional Committee meeting on Monday, September 14, 2026 at 6:45 p.m., via Google Meet
Date of next meeting: Monday, September 28, 2026, Board of Education, 6:30 p.m., BOE Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Blvd, Suite 2
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Suite 2, Wallingford
